person_closed_account_check.name: person_closed_account_check
person_closed_account_check.value: "person"."closed_at" is null or ("person"."phone" is null and not "person"."phone_verified" and not "person"."email_verified" and "person"."email_is_placeholder")

product_published_state_check.name: product_published_state_check
product_published_state_check.value: not "product"."is_published" or ("product"."review_state" = 'approved' and "product"."published_at" is not null)

variant_size_check.name: variant_size_check
variant_size_check.value: ("variant"."size_value" is null and "variant"."size_unit" is null) or ("variant"."size_value" > 0 and "variant"."size_unit" is not null)

price_adjustment_batch_commit_check.name: price_adjustment_batch_commit_check
price_adjustment_batch_commit_check.value: ("price_adjustment_batch"."status" = 'committed') = ("price_adjustment_batch"."committed_by" is not null and "price_adjustment_batch"."committed_at" is not null)

bank_transfer_claim_review_check.name: bank_transfer_claim_review_check
bank_transfer_claim_review_check.value: ("bank_transfer_claim"."status" = 'submitted' and "bank_transfer_claim"."reviewed_by" is null and "bank_transfer_claim"."reviewed_at" is null) or ("bank_transfer_claim"."status" in ('accepted', 'rejected') and "bank_transfer_claim"."reviewed_by" is not null and "bank_transfer_claim"."reviewed_at" is not null)

payment_provider_authority_unique.name: payment_provider_authority_unique
payment_provider_authority_unique.where: "payment"."provider" is not null and "payment"."provider_authority" is not null

payment_provider_reference_unique.name: payment_provider_reference_unique
payment_provider_reference_unique.where: "payment"."provider" is not null and "payment"."provider_reference" is not null

inventory_reservation_resolution_check.name: inventory_reservation_resolution_check
inventory_reservation_resolution_check.value: ("inventory_reservation"."status" = 'active' and "inventory_reservation"."consumed_at" is null and "inventory_reservation"."released_at" is null) or ("inventory_reservation"."status" = 'consumed' and "inventory_reservation"."consumed_at" is not null and "inventory_reservation"."released_at" is null) or ("inventory_reservation"."status" in ('released', 'expired') and "inventory_reservation"."released_at" is not null and "inventory_reservation"."consumed_at" is null)

shipping_rate_national_unique.name: shipping_rate_national_unique
shipping_rate_national_unique.where: "shipping_rate"."is_active" and "shipping_rate"."province_code" is null and "shipping_rate"."city_code" is null

shipping_rate_province_unique.name: shipping_rate_province_unique
shipping_rate_province_unique.where: "shipping_rate"."is_active" and "shipping_rate"."province_code" is not null and "shipping_rate"."city_code" is null

shipping_rate_scope_check.name: shipping_rate_scope_check
shipping_rate_scope_check.value: "shipping_rate"."city_code" is null or "shipping_rate"."province_code" is not null

refund_failed_check.name: refund_failed_check
refund_failed_check.value: "refund"."status" <> 'failed' or ("refund"."failed_at" is not null and "refund"."failure_reason" is not null)

return_request_approved_review_check.name: return_request_approved_review_check
return_request_approved_review_check.value: "return_request"."status" not in ('approved', 'rejected') or "return_request"."reviewed_at" is not null

content_block_scope_check.name: content_block_scope_check
content_block_scope_check.value: ("content_block"."scope_kind" is null and "content_block"."scope_slug" is null) or ("content_block"."scope_kind" is not null and "content_block"."scope_slug" is not null)

content_block_window_check.name: content_block_window_check
content_block_window_check.value: "content_block"."effective_from" is null or "content_block"."effective_until" is null or "content_block"."effective_until" > "content_block"."effective_from"

content_block_translation_cta_check.name: content_block_translation_cta_check
content_block_translation_cta_check.value: ("content_block_translation"."cta_label" is null and "content_block_translation"."cta_href" is null) or ("content_block_translation"."cta_label" is not null and "content_block_translation"."cta_href" is not null)
